adjudication.rationale: In lib/topic_retriever.rb `perform_retrieve` unconditionally calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true (before falling back to HTTP), and this is invoked synchronously on a cache miss (`TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: @embed_url).exists?` is false). The throttle in `retrieved_recently?` is keyed by `retrieved:#{@embed_url}`, so many distinct unknown `embed_url`s can each trigger a full `PollFeed` run within the same minute. `PollFeed#poll_feed` does a network `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and iterates all items creating/updating posts (`TopicEmbed.import` -> `PostCreator`/`PostRevisor`). This is a concrete performance/architecture concern grounded in the diff, not a correctness bug per se.
